openrouter.description: OpenRouter normalized video API, including ByteDance Seedance models. Uses OpenRouter credits and API keys.

default_extra_json.note: OpenCrew sends legacy image-to-video as OpenRouter frame_images[first_frame]. Max SR2 / reference_mode=input_references sends image/audio/video URLs through OpenRouter input_references. If R2 endpoint/bucket are configured, it sends presigned HTTPS URLs; otherwise it falls back to data URLs for small files.
